title: The Empty Witness
author: Wren Iversen
blurb: Jonah Fairweather, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
